title: VisualStoryboard.v1
description: Versioned contract for a sequence of keyframe scenes to be rendered as stills and animated into short video clips. Model output — validated before reaching any GPU execution runtime.

title.description: Human-readable title for the visual sequence.

source_document_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source document that inspired the storyboard.

still_prompt.description: Text prompt for the keyframe still image (SDXL / z-image-turbo).

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to guide away from undesired content.

motion_prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired camera motion / animation style for I2V.

duration_seconds.description: Target duration of the animated clip in seconds.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the still and animated output.

target_lane.description: Preferred GPU lane for this scene's still generation.
